setting_defs_manual_list.note: SETTING_DEFS is a hand-typed array of {key, endpoint, min, max, step} — not generator-derived from the manifest. This is a KNOWN limitation: the manifest's precision/step/minimum/maximum fields are all null (not present as distinct columns in the V2 workbook — see manifest parameter.precision_step_minmax_note), so there is currently no normative source to auto-generate these bounds from. Recorded here for visibility, not silently ignored.

polling_may_overwrite_edited_field.note: preserved_dirty_capture_and_reapply_present=true confirms the full-rebuild diagnostic panel protects pending edits via capture-before/reapply-after rather than a per-assignment guard, so a 'false' dataset_dirty_guard_nearby on one of those specific sites is expected and not a defect by itself — cross-check against the reapply flag before treating any site as unsafe.

packed_fields_without_read_modify_write.note: registers.canonical.json fields do not currently carry an explicit write_uses_read_modify_write flag, so this check cannot positively confirm RMW compliance — it only reports packed RW rows whose canonical register has an effective_access=rw field, as a manual-review worklist. Absence of the flag is not proof of a missing RMW; the flag itself does not yet exist in the schema.

hazard_class_fields_currently_enabled.note: Direct scan of protocol/registers.canonical.json — a non-empty result here means a disruptive/topology/credential/unsupported-class field is currently write-enabled, regardless of manifest coverage. Expected count is 0 under this project's fail-closed policy.
